title: Christiansburg Institute Museum

services.name: Digital Exhibits
services.desc: The Christiansburg Institute Museum & Archives is dedicated to preserving and sharing the history of Christiansburg Industrial Institute, its communities, and the wider African American history in Southwest Virginia. Our digital exhibits are part of our ongoing efforts to make this rich heritage accessible to a wider audience, ensuring that the stories and contributions of those who came before us are never forgotten. We invite you to explore our digital exhibits, engage with our history, and join us in celebrating the enduring legacy of the Christiansburg Industrial Institute.
